Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

About the Role

Responsibilities

  1. Work with QuickBooks Online and/or Desktop

  3. Generate and review P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow reports
  4. Maintain Chart of Accounts, customers, and vendors
  5. Identify accounting errors and workflow issues

Requirements

  1. Hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online and/or Desktop
  2. Strong bookkeeping or accounting background
  3. Experience with financial reporting and reconciliations
  4. Excellent analytical skills and attention to detail

Preferred

  1. Bookkeeper, Accountant, Finance Professional, or Small Business Owner
  2. Experience managing multiple clients or business entities
  3. Familiarity with financial compliance and accounting best practices

Role Title: Bilingual Japanese Psychologist (PhD)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Bilingual Japanese Psychologist (PhD)s to contribute expertise to an innovative customer project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Analyze and assess psychological case studies and documentation, providing nuanced feedback and insights based on professional experience.
  2. Develop culturally sensitive psychological scenarios and materials in both Japanese and English for data enrichment and model training purposes.
  3. Evaluate AI-generated content for accuracy, ethical considerations, and alignment with psychological best practices.
  4. Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to share perspectives and ensure holistic, effective solutions for diverse user needs.
  5. Document evaluation processes and findings clearly and systematically, supporting transparency and reproducibility.
  6. Apply bilingual communication to interpret and refine psychological assessments, ensuring fidelity across languages and cultural contexts.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. PhD in Psychology with demonstrated experience in both clinical and academic settings.
  2. Native or near-native fluency in Japanese and English, with proven ability to navigate complex psychological terminology in both languages.
  3. Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with a track record of ethical decision-making.
  4. Experience developing or evaluating case studies and psychological assessments.
  5. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, especially in translating nuanced psychological concepts between Japanese and English.
  6. Familiarity with digital tools for remote collaboration and effective documentation.
  7. Demonstrated cultural sensitivity and adaptability in multicultural environments.

raw.description:
Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

Your Mission

We're looking for a field-based sales professional to join Teya's rapidly growing sales organisation. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who wants to build a career in sales, develop real commercial skills, and grow within a high-performing, fast-scaling business.

You don't need a sales track record to succeed in this role. What you need is hunger, coachability, and something to prove. We invest heavily in structured onboarding and hands-on coaching because we're not hiring you for who you've been — we're hiring you for who you're going to become.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Proactively identify and engage prospective customers within your defined territory through outreach, networking, referrals and face to face meetings

  • Meet business owners to understand their needs, challenges and goals, and recommend relevant Teya products and solutions.

  • Learn and apply Teya's value-led sales methodology to win new business and achieve performance targets

  • Develop positive, long-term customer relationships that support market penetration, growth and retention.

  • Develop strong knowledge across Teya's products and solutions through our structured training programme

  • Share insights from the field to help improve our products and customer experience

  • Represent Teya as a credible, professional and values-led ambassador within your territory

  • Build positive, long-term customer relationships that support growth and retention

Your Story

This role is about more than just sales — it's a launchpad. It's an opportunity to build genuine commercial confidence, develop transferable sales skills, and create meaningful relationships with business owners from day one.

We're not looking for a finished product. We're looking for potential, drive, and the right mindset — the rest we'll teach you.

We're looking for people who bring:

  • A competitive mindset and a genuine desire to win

  • Strong work ethic and high activity orientation — you show up and put the reps in

  • Coachability — you take feedback, apply it, and improve fast

  • Curiosity and learning agility

  • Ambition and resilience — you treat setbacks as information, not defeat

  • Emotional intelligence and the ability to read a room or a customer

  • Self-direction and a proactive, self-driven mindset

  • Confidence engaging with new people and building rapport quickly

  • Effective time management and organisational skills

  • A collaborative, team-oriented approach

  • A strong willingness to learn and continuously develop

  • Fluency in English

  • A full UK driving licence

This is a fully field-based sales role. You must be located in Surrey.

The Perks

  • Competitive basic salary plus commission, with typical on-target earnings of £50,000 in your first year

  • 25 days of Annual Leave + Bank Holidays

  • Physical and mental health support through our partnership with GymPass, 1-1 therapy sessions, meditation sessions, and access to digital fitness and nutrition apps

  • Extended and improved maternity and paternity leave choices

  • Private Medical and Life Insurance

  • Pension Scheme

Teya is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, including those without a traditional sales or commercial track record.

Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us.

raw.description:
We’re seeking a skilled Full-Stack Engineer to build the next-generation data management and artificial intelligence platform for maritime domain awareness.

Spear AI is a growing defense contracting company dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions that support our nation’s security. As we expand, we’re building a culture where innovation meets mission-critical work. We operate with a flat organizational structure that empowers every team member to make an impact, collaborate directly with leadership, and contribute to projects that matter. Whether you’re joining our Hardware, Software, or Services division, you’ll work alongside talented professionals who are committed to excellence and advancing the capabilities that keep our nation safe and secure.

Spear AI builds sonobuoy sensors that are deployed into the water and collect edge data. We also work with the U.S. Navy to collect and process their SONAR data. You’ll have an opportunity to work on real-world projects that directly impact warfighter capabilities and mission success.

What you’ll do

We’re a small team wearing many hats, and you’d have a wide variety of responsibilities that include:

  • Build out application components and pages.

  • Implement historical and real-time data feeds using WebGPU.

  • Design and develop data models using Postgres and Apache Iceberg.

  • Modify real-time data pipelines using MQTT and Redpanda.

  • Modify offline data pipelines using Dagster for batch processing.

  • Modify and integrate machine learning models or other algorithms into the application.

  • Improve local development and CI/CD using modern tooling and GitHub Actions.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone with strong Full-Stack Engineering skills who shares our most important values:

  • You’re fanatical about polish. Every detail matters. You love to make sure your code is linted, formatted, fully typed, and has 100% test coverage.

  • You care about correctness. You take pride in the fact that downstream consumers trust libraries and services you build.

  • You obsess over performance. You daydream about Lighthouse scores and query speed.

  • You dive deep. It’s important for you to really know how things work. You’re always building prototypes and setting up experiments to reinforce your understanding.

  • You live on the bleeding edge. You’ve got a long list of upcoming platform features you’re excited about and can’t wait for the next nightly to drop.

  • You’re a great teacher. You know how to break down a concept for a specific audience and make it click with them in a way that gets them excited.

Why work with us

  • We ship — We don’t work on 18-month projects that are irrelevant before they’re even finished.

  • Our work has impact — We build products that are deployed to U.S. submarines and integrate with the sonobuoys we manufacture.

  • We’re growing responsibly — We have the resources to hire a lot more people, but we don’t want to build a massive team of people who don’t share our values.

  • We’re remote — Work from wherever you want. We collaborate in real time on Slack or asynchronously via GitHub.

  • We’re profitable — We aren’t burning through cash trying to make the business work. But we also have investors who believe in us and are committed to our success.

  • We care about doing great work — You don’t need permission to sweat the details here.

  • We don’t take ourselves too seriously — We’re building products that make the world safer. But we don’t let that get to our heads.

Important skills

  • Expertise in TypeScript.

  • Expertise in CSS, such as TailwindCSS.

  • Experience with React and frontend frameworks such as Next.js.

  • Familiar with state management such as React Context.

  • Experience with Node.js, GraphQL, and REST APIs.

  • Proficiency with SQL/PostgreSQL.

  • Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Knowledge of Python.

Nice to have

  • Experience with IoT devices and sensors.

  • Digital signal processing experience.

  • Geospatial analysis and GIS experience.

  • Familiar with working in monorepos.

What we offer

  • Unlimited PTO — Take the time you need to recharge and maintain work-life balance.

  • Dedicated sick time — Your health and well-being come first.

  • Comprehensive health and benefits – Medical, dental, and vision coverage to keep you and your family protected.

  • 11 Paid Holidays — Enjoy time off throughout the year to celebrate and spend time with loved ones.

  • Professional development — Educational opportunities and resources to help you grow your skills and advance your career.

  • Collaborative environment — Work directly with leadership in our flat organizational structure, where your ideas and contributions matter.

  • Mission-driven work — Contribute to projects that directly support national security and make a real-world impact.

  • Growth opportunities — Join us during an exciting expansion phase where you can help shape our future.

Additional benefit opportunities when you choose Spear AI:

  • 401(k) with company match.

  • Onsite / Remote / Flexible work arrangements or hybrid options (position dependent).

  • Relocation assistance (position dependent).

  • Referral bonuses.

  • Performance bonuses.

  • Life insurance and disability coverage.

  • Technology home office setup stipend.

  • Professional certification reimbursement (position dependent).

We offer competitive compensation tailored to your experience, location, and the impact you’ll make. We’re committed to equitable pay and will share a range aligned to your level and geography during the hiring process. In accordance with state law, candidates in jurisdictions such as CA, CO, WA, NY, and others, where applicable, will be provided a good-faith salary range upon request and throughout the hiring process. This is a full-time, exempt position under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) and is not eligible for overtime pay.

Compensation for this position is provided on a salaried basis and is not subject to reduction based on hours worked. At Spear AI, you’ll find more than just a job; you’ll join a mission-driven team where your work directly contributes to national security. Our flat organizational structure means your voice matters, your ideas reach leadership, and your impact is visible. As we grow, we’re committed to building robust processes and infrastructure that support both our mission and our people. We value collaboration, continuous improvement, and the expertise each team member brings to the table. If you’re looking for a place to grow professionally while working on projects that truly matter, we’d love to hear from you.

  3. Current access to Altium Designer and ability to use the application independently.
  4. Comfortable recording and sharing your screen while completing Altium Designer workflows.
  5. Strong attention to detail and ability to clearly explain technical workflows.

Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

Your Mission

raw.excerpt: About the RoleWe're looking for a senior content leader to own the voice of two brands: Darkroom, our growth marketing agency, and Shadow, our AI commerce platform.
raw.description:
About the Role

We're looking for a senior content leader to own the voice of two brands: Darkroom, our growth marketing agency, and Shadow, our AI commerce platform. Ad Age recently described us as "if Omnicom was rebuilt on AI." Your job is to turn a line like that into an argument the market repeats back to us. The split is roughly 80% Darkroom, 20% Shadow.

We are making a category bet on the forward-deployed marketer, the operator who sits inside a business and builds with AI rather than briefing the work out. We intend to make that a term of art through Darkroom: the article, the LinkedIn engine, the video, the webinars, the press. You own that campaign end to end.

You'll report to our VP of Marketing, who sets direction and makes the calls. You'll help shape the thinking behind it: how content maps to the funnel, which channels carry which offers, and what actually turns attention into pipeline. Then you build the content that proves it.

Our marketing operations manager owns the calendar, the publishing, and the deployment. You make the content that fills all of it, across LinkedIn, video, email, paid, and creator, and you brief our designer, video editor, and SEO specialist so one idea becomes a post, a video, an email, and an ad in the same week. This isn't a writing-only role.

Alongside content, you own the creative half of the creator program: who we work with, what we ask them to make, and the call on whether we go wide with many creators or deep with a few. You source and negotiate the partnerships and write the briefs. Marketing Ops runs the admin behind it. Creator content is one of our two strongest lead sources today and the one with the most room left in it.

This is a New York-based role operating in the EST Time Zone, hybrid out of our new NYC office, and all business is conducted 100% in English.

What you'll do

  • Brand Narrative: Define and defend what Darkroom and Shadow say. Own the positioning arguments, the category bet, and the point of view that shows up everywhere else.

  • Funnel & Strategy: Work with the VP of Marketing on how content builds pipeline: which channels, which offers, which lead magnets, and what the content has to do at each stage. You help build the model, then you feed it.

  • LinkedIn & Video: Build our LinkedIn engine across the company page and our executives' accounts, including video made for the feed it runs in. This is where our buyers spend their day and where we have the most ground to take.

  • Creator Strategy & Briefs: Decide who we work with and what they make. Source creators, negotiate the partnerships, write the briefs, and set the strategy between a wide roster and a small group of anchor creators. Marketing Ops handles the CRM, deadlines, content collection and reporting.

  • Email & Newsletter: Own what goes into our newsletter and to our list. Marketing Ops handles deployment. The thinking, the cadence, and the reason anyone opens it are yours.

  • Shadow Content: Take Shadow's content from scattered to a funnel: posts into webinars and lead magnets into signups. Product marketing for a platform that sells to operators.

  • Paid Copy: Partner with our designer, video editor and performance team on the words behind our ads, so the organic and creator assets that work become the ads that work.

  • Editorial Direction: Brief the team, review the work, and hold a consistent standard across every surface both brands touch.

  • Events & Moments: Turn our NYC office, our activations, and our press into content programs instead of one-off posts.

  • Measurement: Work with Marketing Ops on the weekly scoreboard: reach, follower growth, earned media value, and how content traffic converts.

You should apply if this sounds like you

  • 5+ years in content, brand, or creator marketing, from an agency or a commerce brand, with B2B or pipeline accountability. SaaS or martech experience is a plus.

  • You have owned content that was accountable to a business number. You can explain how a post becomes traffic, becomes a conversion, becomes a lead, and you have been graded at the end of that chain. If content has always been someone else's funnel, this role is not for you.

  • You know this world. DTC, e-commerce, performance marketing, social commerce, AI tooling. You can write about TikTok Shop, retention, or attribution without a briefing and without getting it wrong.

  • You have sourced, negotiated with, and briefed creators yourself. You know what separates a brief that produces something usable from one that wastes everybody's month.

  • You have a public track record. A newsletter, bylines, a brand account you grew, a campaign that landed, a term you helped popularize. Send the link.

  • You get output out of people who don't report to you, and you can give a designer or an editor feedback that makes the next version better.

  • You arrive with a list. In the first interview, we will ask what you would change about our LinkedIn, our newsletter, and our creator content. We expect specifics.

  • You already work with Claude, ChatGPT, or similar daily and have shipped real work with them. We are a Claude-first company.

Hard disqualifiers

  • No published writing or no portfolio link.

  • Never sourced or briefed a creator yourself.

  • Content experience with no accountability for pipeline.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

What are we looking for?

We’re hiring a Technical Support Engineer to help our top customers solve the hardest technical problems in apps built on Hercules. You will handle complex debugging, provide architecture guidance, and unblock high-value users fast.

You should be:

  • Strong technically: you can reason about full-stack systems and debug unfamiliar code quickly.

  • Customer-oriented: clear communicator who can translate complexity into next steps.

  • Fast and thorough: you triage efficiently, reproduce issues, and drive to resolution.

  • Product-minded: you turn recurring issues into fixes, docs, and automation.

What will you lead?

  • Own escalations: take the most technical support tickets and unblock users quickly

  • Deep debugging: reproduce issues, inspect logs, isolate root causes, and propose fixes/workarounds

  • Architecture guidance: advise on app structure, data modeling, auth, payments, performance, and deployment patterns

  • Incident handling: diagnose platform issues vs user issues, coordinate internally, communicate status clearly

  • Knowledge base: write high-signal docs, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides

  • Automation: build tooling to detect common failures, generate better diagnostics, and reduce repeat tickets

  • Feedback loop: surface product gaps, propose improvements, and help implement fixes where needed

What skills do we expect you to have?

  • Strong TypeScript and modern web fundamentals (HTTP, APIs, auth, databases)

  • Proven ability to debug production issues (logs, traces, repros, minimal test cases)

  • Strong systems thinking: architecture (scalability, reliability, performance, security basics)

  • Excellent written communication: concise explanations, clear action plans, good incident updates

  • Experience working in a customer facing role (sales, pre-sales, customer support, etc)

  • Ideally experience supporting developers or working in a high-velocity product environment

Will you always be a technical support engineer?

If you’d like to, yes. However, after 6-12 months we are open to working with you to transition you to a full time software engineering, pre-sales, or post-sales engineering role

What are Hercules’ operating principles?

Hercules’ operating principles guide how we make decisions every day. We take them very seriously. Most of them are specifically choices that we as a company unique prioritize and so can be learned on the job. However, we do specifically filter for these principles our hiring process:

  1. We move with urgency. We ship fast, iterate, and correct mistakes quickly. Our bias for action speeds our learning and delights our customers.

  2. We strive for excellence. Doing things well is in our DNA. We have good taste. We get the details right. Our outputs are exceptionally simple and self-serve. We’re proud of our work.

  3. We are hungry. We are willing to work hard and break through walls to achieve the outcomes we want. We are willing to operate at any level to get things done. We are politely relentless.

Is Hercules in-office or remote?

Hercules founding team works in-office in San Francisco (Kearny and Bush). We have a very strong preference for in office. We are open to remote for exceptional candidates in US time zones who would be willing/able to travel to the office regularly.

What are Hercules’ benefits?

  • Healthcare, vision, and dental

  • Use whatever AI productivity tools you’d like

  • Take what you need vacation policy

  • Daily lunches, dinners and snacks in the office

  • We guarantee you will do the best work of your career here

What’s the compensation?

$80k-$175k USD + equity (depends on seniority, equity, and location)

Compensation Range: $80K - $150K

  • Implement algorithmic/AI logic in the backend (e.g., scoring, ranking, routing, decision rules).

  • Help shape how we build things: patterns, conventions, and how we ship and iterate as we grow.

  • Solid understanding of relational data modeling and SQL (we use PostgreSQL).

  • Comfortable designing and building RESTful APIs (bonus if you’ve used DRF or similar frameworks).

  • Experience working on non-trivial business logic or algorithms (e.g., decision flows, scoring rules, optimization logic).

  • Good instincts around performance: understanding query behavior, avoiding obvious pitfalls, and using caching when it counts.

  • A startup mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, moving fast, and iterating based on real-world feedback.

  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment and communicate clearly.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience in startups, side projects, or hackathons where you’ve had to ship scrappy solutions fast.

  • Background in algorithms, optimization, or data-heavy systems.

  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) in production.

  • Familiarity with Redis (caching, queues) and PostgreSQL at some scale.

  • Exposure to containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and/or serverless on GCP.

This role is a central piece of our backend roadmap, and we’re aiming to fill it quickly once we meet the right person. If it resonates with you, go ahead and apply now.

raw.title: Paid Media & Tracking Assistant
raw.excerpt: We are looking for a hands-on Paid Media & Tracking Assistant to support our digital advertising, analytics, and tracking efforts across multiple paid media platforms.
raw.description:
We are looking for a hands-on Paid Media & Tracking Assistant to support our digital advertising, analytics, and tracking efforts across multiple paid media platforms. The ideal candidate has practical experience setting up, maintaining, and troubleshooting advertising pixels, events, conversion tracking, and analytics systems, with a strong understanding of how paid traffic is measured and optimized.

You will work closely with the marketing team to ensure that campaigns are properly tracked, conversions are accurately recorded, and our tracking infrastructure provides reliable data for reporting and optimization. This role is particularly suited to someone who enjoys working directly with ad platforms, analytics tools, event tracking, and campaign data rather than focusing solely on strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Set up, manage, and troubleshoot Meta Pixel, Meta Events Manager, and custom events/conversions.

  • Support paid advertising campaigns across platforms such as Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Reddit Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.

  • Define and maintain a clear event tracking structure, including event names, parameters, properties, and conversion definitions.

  • Implement and validate pixels, events, conversion tracking, UTM parameters, and other tracking solutions across websites and campaigns.

  • Work with the tracking stack, including PostHog, GA4, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Meta Events Manager, Brevo, and Microsoft Clarity.

  • Monitor tracking performance and investigate discrepancies between advertising platforms, analytics tools, and website data.

  • Debug tracking issues and identify why an event or conversion is not firing correctly, rather than only setting up campaigns.

  • Test and validate events across different platforms to ensure that data is being captured accurately and consistently.

  • Ensure that key events and conversions are properly defined, recorded, and attributed across the relevant platforms.

  • Assist with campaign setup, audience tracking, retargeting, and conversion measurement.

  • Analyze campaign and tracking data to identify potential issues and opportunities for improvement.

  • Work with websites, landing pages, and analytics tools to ensure proper data collection and attribution.

  • Help maintain organized tracking documentation and ensure that event naming and tracking structures remain consistent.

  • Stay up to date with changes to advertising platforms, tracking technologies, attribution, and privacy requirements.

  • Support testing and troubleshooting of new tracking setups before campaigns go live.

Preferred Experience

  • Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, Meta Pixel, Meta Events Manager, and custom events/conversions.

  • Experience with TikTok Ads, Reddit Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.

  • Practical experience with PostHog, GA4, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Microsoft Clarity, and Brevo.

  • Strong understanding of event tracking concepts, including event names, parameters, properties, conversion definitions, and attribution.

  • Experience troubleshooting tracking issues and identifying why events or conversions may not be firing, recording, or attributing correctly.

  • Familiarity with server-side tracking / Conversions API is a strong plus.

  • Experience with newer or emerging advertising platforms, including ChatGPT Ads, would be a significant advantage.

  • Comfortable working with data, spreadsheets, dashboards, and campaign performance reports.

  • Strong attention to detail and a hands-on, problem-solving mindset.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is practical, detail-oriented, and technically curious. You should be comfortable getting into the actual ad platforms and tracking tools, testing events yourself, investigating discrepancies, and figuring out why something is not working as expected.

The ideal candidate should be able to go beyond simply setting up campaigns or implementing pixels. They should understand how the entire tracking flow works, from defining an event and its parameters to ensuring that it fires correctly, is captured by the relevant analytics tools, and is ultimately reflected as a meaningful conversion.

You do not need to be an advanced developer, but you should be confident working with tracking tools, advertising platforms, basic website elements, and analytics systems. Experience working across multiple paid media channels and the ability to quickly learn and troubleshoot new platforms are highly valued.

raw.description:
We’re a remote, product-focused startup building AI- and algorithm-driven systems, and we’re looking for a strong Backend Django Engineer who loves clean data models, well-designed APIs, and clever algorithms.

You’ll own core backend features end-to-end: from modeling the data to implementing the logic and exposing it through fast, reliable services that ship to users quickly, working with a small distributed team across several countries.

💰 $100 bonus: After successfully completing the assessment. To receive the assessment,
please submit your resume to this job application. If your resume is approved, you'll receive the

assessment afterwards.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and implement backend servicesand APIs using Python+ Django (and DRF or similar).

  • Model and evolve our domain in the database with clean, well-structured schemas and relationships.

  • Implement algorithmic/AI logicin the backend (e.g., scoring, ranking, routing, decision rules).

  • Write pragmatic, production-ready code that’s easy to reason about and iterate on.

  • Optimize for correctness and performance: efficient queries, smart indexing, and lean responses.

  • Work with the team to turn product ideas into concrete technical designs and endpoints.

  • Help shape how we build things: patterns, conventions, and how we ship and iterate as we grow.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong experience building backend applications with Python + Django.

  • Solid understanding of relational data modeling and SQL (we use PostgreSQL).

  • Comfortable designing and building RESTful APIs (bonus if you’ve used DRF or similarframeworks).

  • Experience working onnon-trivial business logic or algorithms (e.g., decision flows,scoring rules, optimization logic).

  • Good instincts aroundperformance: understanding query behavior, avoiding obviouspitfalls, and using caching when it counts.

  • Astartup mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, moving fast, and iterating based on real-world feedback.

  • Ability to workindependently in a remote environment and communicate clearly.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience in startups, side projects, or hackathons where you’ve had to ship scrappy solutions fast.

  • Background inalgorithms, optimization, or data-heavy systems.

  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) in production.

  • Familiarity with Redis (caching, queues) and PostgreSQL at some scale.

  • Exposure to containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and/or serverless on GCP.

This role is a central piece of our backend roadmap, and we’re aiming to fill it quickly once we meet the right person. If it resonates with you, go ahead and apply now.
Send us your resume to start the assessment process (and get a chance at the $100 bonus).

Therapist - Women’s Mental Health (Texas)

Are you passionate about making a meaningful impact in women’s mental health care? Here's your chance to be a vital part of FamilyWell's mission to enhance access to high-quality, equitable, and affordable mental health services for pregnant, postpartum, and menopausal individuals across the U.S.

Background:

FamilyWell Health is an AI-enabled mental health start-up dedicated to solving the women’s mental health crisis by seamlessly embedding high quality, equitable, & affordable mental health care into OB/Gyn practices. FamilyWell provides comprehensive virtual mental health services designed specifically for integration into OB/Gyn and Family Medicine practices utilizing the psychiatric collaborative care model. FamilyWell’s virtual care team model delivers evidence-based coaching, therapy, care coordination, and psychiatric services with specialized expertise in perinatal mental health and perimenopause/menopause. For more information: .

Role:

Location: RemoteDepartment: Care OperationsJob type: Part-time, 10-30 hours per week as a 1099/contractorCompensation: $70 per 60-minute session (inclusive of intake and follow-up) plus 2-hour allotment per month for administrative compensation

Patient Care & Support Responsibilities:

  • Provide individual tele-therapy to patients requesting regular sessions using FamilyWell’s virtual platform.
  • Conduct one-on-one psychological intakes for referred FamilyWell program patients, gathering comprehensive assessments to inform treatment planning.
  • Document patient progress comprehensively, sharing treatment recommendations with medical providers, psychiatric consultants, and other treating professionals as needed.
    Facilitate treatment plan modifications for patients needing more intensive or specialized mental health care, ensuring timely and appropriate interventions.
  • Develop and deliver Care Plans post-session, offering patients actionable insights and follow-up steps.

Qualifications:

  • Licensed mental health provider who holds an active license in Texas. All applicants must be able to practice independently / without supervision.

Licensures that qualify include the following:

  • Licensed Independent Clinical Social Worker (LICSW)
  • Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC)
  • Licensed Marriage Family Therapist (LMFT)
  • Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC)

Experience:

  • Formal perinatal/peri/menopause mental health training or a minimum of 1 year of clinical experience working with pregnant and/or postpartum and/or peri/menopause patients is strongly preferred.

raw.title: Personal Sales Assistant
raw.excerpt: Alles wat je zoekt in je nieuwe commerciële baan: eigen verantwoordelijkheid, parttime werken op tijden die je zelf bepaalt.
raw.description:
Alles wat je zoekt in je nieuwe commerciële baan: eigen verantwoordelijkheid, parttime werken op tijden die je zelf bepaalt. Wij geven je de kans om het beste uit jezelf te halen.

Ben jij als enthousiaste, gedreven, zelfstandige (eventueel in het buitenland wonende) professional op zoek naar de juiste REMOTE parttime functie? Waarin je veel vrijheid krijgt EN kunt groeien in de sales? Dan zoeken wij jou! Als Personal Sales Assistant ben jij de schakel tussen ons bedrijf en onze opdrachtgevers. Je zult klanten telefonisch benaderen, offertes opvolgen en verantwoordelijk zijn voor het onderhoud van klantrelaties. Dit doe je vanuit huis (wáár je ook woont), met flexibele werktijden die passen bij jouw schema.

Wat houdt de functie in?Als Personal Sales Assistant (PSA) ga jij voor jouw opdrachtgever leads nabellen. Dit kan variëren van het opbellen van websitebezoekers tot prospects die benaderd zijn via een e-mailcampagne. Je belt lauwe tot warme leads na en probeert afspraken te scoren voor jouw opdrachtgever.

Als je start als PSA word je getraind in het werken in Mijn DATA-collectief, de meest actuele B2B-database van Nederland waar jij jouw acties in gaat bijhouden. Je leert hoe je geautomatiseerd e-mails kunt versturen en je trajecten kunt bijhouden via acties. Jouw opdrachtgever heeft toegang tot hetzelfde systeem zodat jullie gezamenlijk gemakkelijk leads kunnen kwalificeren en hij/zij alle voortgang inzichtelijk heeft. Je gaat dus écht samenwerken om het beste uit iedere dag te halen.

Als PSA sta je direct in contact met je opdrachtgever. Je wordt door hem of haar gezien als een verlenging van hun salesafdeling. Hierdoor zijn de lijntjes kort en kun je gemakkelijk sparren over de juiste aanpak. Merk jij dat een bepaalde insteek beter werkt dan een andere? Dan kun je dat dus direct afstemmen. Doorgaan werk je vanuit huis, waarbij wij jou de software leveren om jouw werk succesvol te kunnen doen. In overleg kun je ook bij de opdrachtgever op kantoor werken. Kortom, je gaat écht hybride werken.

Met jouw inzet verhoog je meetbaar de omzet van je klanten door:

  • ervoor te zorgen dat de bedrijfsgegevens van de opdrachtgever altijd actueel zijn

  • prospects te selecteren, leads te genereren en telefonisch te benaderen

  • afspraken te boeken en te zorgen voor terugkoppeling en afstemming met je opdrachtgever en/of accountmanager

  • verkoopontspanning te bieden aan je opdrachtgever, door middel van het doorzetten van goede gesprekken of genereren van afspraken waar hij/zij alleen nog maar de sales hoeft in te koppen!

Hoe committed ben jij aan ons?

Omdat we gemerkt hebben dat veel mensen toch wel erg gemakkelijk instappen in de functie van Personal Sales Assistant, maar er even gemakkelijk weer uitstappen, hebben we een constructie bedacht die ons helpt de juiste kandidaten te selecteren en aan ons te binden, door middel van een beloningssysteem dat twee kanten op werkt en waarin wij jou belonen voor jouw commitment aan ons.

Wat houdt dit in?
Als jij ervoor kiest om jezelf een upgrade te geven als sales professional met de garantie op een leuke parttime (bij)baan, vol vrijheid, leuke opdrachten die je vanuit huis kunt invullen én de zekerheid van een continu inkomen, dan doen wij er alles aan om jou daarbij te helpen.

Zo bieden wij jou een training aan van 2 tot 6 weken, waarin we jou vingervlug maken in ons CRM-systeem en meteen ook je telefonische sales skills opkrikken, zodat jij jouw werk met NOG MEER zelfvertrouwen kunt doen. Maar daar vragen we WEL iets voor terug...

In ruil voor onze investering in jou om jou te trainen tot sales professional (met de kwalificaties die onze opdrachtgevers van jou en ons verwachten) en jou baangarantie te bieden, vragen we jou een Zelf-investering te doen. Die investering houdt in dat je de eerste 8 uur van de training (die bestaat uit de eerste fase van de training, waarin je de basisskills leert) IN EERSTE INSTANTIE niet betaald krijgt. Dan, als jij beide fases van de training door bent en 6 maanden naar tevredenheid voor ons werkt, krijg jij naast je wekelijkse uren uitbetaling die initiële 8 uur alsnog vergoed plus iets extra’s in de vorm van een eenmalige commitmentbonus à € 350,00.

Op deze manier zijn wij er zeker van dat jij er goed over nagedacht hebt of deze functie inderdaad DE functie voor jou is en dat je er 100% voor gaat. En ben JIJ verzekerd van een extra leuk zakcentje. WIN-WIN voor iedereen!

Dus ben jij ervan overtuigd dat jij de Personal Sales Assistant bent die wij zoeken? Laat het ons weten en solliciteer nu!

Requirements

Vereisten:

  • minimaal mbo-niveau

  • minstens 2 jaar commerciële werk- en belervaring, bijvoorbeeld als (assistent-) accountmanager, callcenter agent of medewerker commerciële binnendienst

  • vlotte computervaardigheden en, indien je vanuit huis werkt, een snelle/ stabiele internetverbinding

  • prettige telefoonstem en uitstekende mondelinge en schriftelijke beheersing van de Nederlandse taal

  • een dienstverlenende, nauwkeurige instelling

  • een zelfstandige, ondernemende werkhouding

  • enig bedrijfsmatig inzicht om mee te kunnen denken met de klant is een pré!

Dit bieden wij jou:

  • een uurtarief van € 20,00 per uur (starttarief) tot € 30,00 per uur op basis van een ZZP-contract (je tarief loopt op naar mate je langer voor ons werkt)

  • werktijden die je voor een groot deel zelf bepaalt, met een minimum van 8 uur per week (en max wat je maar wil)

  • flexibiliteit en vrijheid in je werkplek

  • prettige werkomstandigheden

  • een professioneel trainingsprogramma, tevens flexibel en vanuit huis te volgen

About TCP (TimeClock Plus):

For more than 30 years, TCP has helped organizations engage their people by providing flexible, mobile timekeeping and workforce management solutions. Trusted by tens of thousands of customers and millions of users, TCP delivers best-in-class technology and personalized support to organizations of all sizes in the public and private sector to meet their complex timekeeping, employee scheduling, leave management and other workforce needs. Growth is happening and our vision for a successful future is clear - We'd love for you to join us on this journey! For more information on TCP, visit or follow us on LinkedIn or Facebook. 

As a Enterprise Account Executive, you will: 

  • Identify as a subject matter expert and advisor to prospective customers, through knowledge of current trends and topics of interest within assigned market segment(s).

Communication & Presence

  • Strong written communication skills for emails, proposals, and presentations.

  • Emotional intelligence and ability to read room dynamics effectively.

Industry & Product Fit

  • Previous B2B SaaS or intangible solution sales experience preferred.

Coachability & Culture

  • Growth mindset and openness to feedback.

  • Evidence of teamwork over “lone wolf” approaches.

Physical Requirements:

Benefits

raw.description:
The Health & Wellness Specialist is a highly mobile, expert clinical resource who supports Experience Senior Living communities through hands-on guidance, temporary leadership coverage, stabilization support, and best-practice execution. This role is 100% travel-based and is deployed to communities experiencing vacancies, transitions, performance gaps, regulatory risk, or heightened operational need within the Health & Wellness and Memory Care functions.

The Specialist works side-by-side with community teams, providing clinical expertise, training, coaching, and direct operational support while reinforcing ESL standards, regulatory compliance, and resident care excellence. While this role does not hold permanent supervisory responsibility, it may temporarily perform essential functions of the Director of Health & Wellness during vacancies, onboarding periods, or short-term assignments.

Clinical Leadership & Operational Support

  • Serve as an on-site clinical expert and operational resource to Executive Directors, Directors of Health & Wellness, and wellness Teams.
  • Provide hands-on support and guidance in resident assessments, care planning, medication management, staffing, documentation, clinical oversight and clinical decision-making.
  • Temporarily assume Director of Health & Wellness /Director of Memory Care responsibilities during vacancies, leaves of absence, onboarding periods, or periods of increased operational need, ensuring continuity of care and regulatory compliance.
  • Provide clinical input, manage and support resident assessment process including move-ins, transfers, and care level appropriateness when requested.
  • Support communities in addressing resident and family concerns related to care delivery, clinical decisions, or transitions.
  • Promote person-centered care practices that uphold dignity, respect, and quality of life.

Training, Coaching & Capability Building

  • Deliver side-by-side training and coaching to Health & Wellness leaders and wellness team members, reinforcing ESL standards, policies, and best practices.
  • Support onboarding and transition of newly hired Directors of Health & Wellness through real-time guidance, mentoring, and skills check reinforcement.
  • Educate teams on resident rights, dignity, infection control, documentation standards, medication administration, and clinical workflows.
  • Reinforce accountability and consistency without assuming long-term people management authority.
  • Support communities in achieving and sustaining a “survey-ready” environment at all times.

Quality, Compliance & Risk Management

  • In partnership with Divisional support and Quality Assurance, participate in scheduled clinical audits, site visits, and operational reviews to assess compliance with ESL standards and applicable state and federal regulations.
  • Identify trends in incidents, falls, medication errors, infections, and documentation gaps; partner with community and divisional leadership on corrective action planning.
  • Provide guidance during regulatory surveys, follow-up visits, or corrective action periods as directed by the SVP, Health & Wellness.
  • Ensure appropriate partnerships with ancillary service providers (home health, hospice, therapy, etc.) to support resident outcomes.

Collaboration & Travel

  • Partner closely with the SVP, Health & Wellness, Divisional Operations leaders, and community Executive Directors to prioritize deployments based on business need.
  • Maintain flexibility to deploy rapidly to communities across the operating and developing portfolio.
  • Provide timely feedback, observations, and recommendations following assignments to inform ongoing improvement efforts.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Maintain required licensure across assigned states.
  • Participate in on-call or emergency clinical support as directed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned consistent with the scope and intent of the Specialist role.

Requirements

  • Graduate of an accredited school of nursing.
  • Registered Nurse (RN) preferred; LPN/LVN may be considered with significant senior living leadership experience.
  • Minimum three (3) years of clinical leadership experience in assisted living, memory care, or senior living health care operations in a senior living, recreation; multi-site or regional experience preferred.
  • Active, unrestricted nursing license in each assigned state (or ability to obtain).
  • Strong knowledge of assisted living regulations, clinical compliance, assessments, medication management, and quality assurance.
  • Ability to travel 100% of the time, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and familiarity with systems such as Sherpa, UKG, OnShift and SharePoint preferred.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to meet company driving standards required.

Benefits

We offer a full benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, STD/LTD, life and voluntary life, 401k with employer matching, paid holidays, and up to 20 days PTO in the first three years.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of background screening in accordance with Florida law and company policy. raw.excerpt: At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease.
raw.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.

The US LNG Reporter is responsible for delivering timely, accurate, and insightful coverage of the US LNG and natural gas markets. The role focuses on domestic gas production, feed gas flows, pipeline and LNG infrastructure, LNG export activity, and the US regulatory landscape, while examining how developments in the U.S. market intersect with global LNG trade, pricing, and shipping.

Through original reporting and analysis, the role translates Kpler’s data and market intelligence into clear, news-driven insights that help clients understand market movements, risks, and emerging trends across the LNG value chain.

Your mission is to

  • Produce timely, accurate, and insightful news and analysis on US LNG and natural gas markets, including supply, demand and pricing dynamics, and clearly explain how these developments impact global LNG trade, pricing, and shipping flows.
  • Write sharp, concise, and compelling news copy,
  • Monitor US gas production, feed gas flows, pipeline capacity, LNG export terminals, liquefaction buildout, using Kpler and industry sources, and regulatory developments (including FERC and DOE).
  • Generate original story ideas, including breaking news and exclusives, demonstrating curiosity and initiative to identify trends, anomalies, and underreported developments.
  • Use Kpler data and tools to identify trends, spot anomalies, and originate data-led stories,
  • Collaborate closely with reporters, analysts, and data teams to shape story angles, extract meaningful insights and ensure consistent coverage across the LNG value chain.
  • Develop and leverage a strong network of industry and regulatory contacts to break news, validate information, and deliver exclusive insights.
  • React quickly to breaking developments and deliver accurate coverage under tight deadlines.

You could be a match if you have

  • 2+ years’ experience in business, energy, or commodities journalism, delivering news under deadline pressure.
  • Direct experience covering LNG and/or US natural gas markets, with a clear grasp of how US gas market dynamics connect to global LNG flows, pricing, and shipping.
  • Strong understanding of commodities markets, including how supply, demand and pricing interact.
  • Proven ability to work independently, with minimal supervision, producing a steady flow of stories in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong track record of accurate reporting and sound editorial judgment, with the ability to identify the most market-relevant developments and explain their implications clearly.

Remote role in the USA

Role Overview 🚀

This is a high-velocity, phone-first sales role for an experienced AE who lives for the daily scoreboard. You'll own a high-volume pipeline of US e-commerce SMBs — Amazon, Shopify, Walmart, and DTC brands — running back-to-back calls, working inbound and outbound activity, and closing smaller-ticket deals at pace.

We're not training you up. We're hiring you because you already know how to run a fast cycle. Pick up the phone, qualify hard, get a yes or a no, move on. If you're motivated by activity targets, response SLAs, weekly leaderboards, and the ring of a deal-closed bell, you'll fit right in.

About Uncapped 👫

Founded in 2019, Uncapped is a leading fintech provider of working & growth capital to e-commerce companies in North America and Europe. We leverage multiple data sources and use cutting-edge models to make credit decisions faster and safer. We work with some of the largest global e-commerce platforms — including Amazon and Walmart — and strive to be the best alternative lender globally.

What will you do ✍️

  • Run a high-velocity sales motion focused on US e-commerce SMBs
  • Hit aggressive daily activity targets: dials, connects, deals worked, deals closed
  • Own deals end-to-end on a short cycle — first call to closed-won in days, not months
  • Work the phones hard. Telephony is the primary channel, supported by email, LinkedIn, and SMS cadences
  • Hit inbound lead-response SLAs in minutes, not hours, and follow up with relentless cadence discipline
  • Maintain pristine HubSpot hygiene — every call logged, every deal stage accurate, every next step booked
  • Articulate Uncapped's value to e-commerce founders quickly, handle objections in real time, and drive to a decision
  • Compete on the leaderboard every week, every month, every quarter — and help your team win
  • Partner with senior AEs and the credit team to push deals through diligence without losing velocity

How you'll be measured 📊

  • Activity: dials, connect rate, talk time, emails sent, sequences enrolled
  • Velocity: speed-to-lead, cycle length, time-in-stage, win-rate at each stage
  • SLAs: inbound response time, follow-up adherence, CRM hygiene
  • Winning: deals closed, revenue booked, quota attainment, leaderboard rank

Requirements

Who you are 👀

We care more about mindset and potential than experience. Here's what will set you apart:

  • You’re ambitious and hungry to build a career in sales. You’re willing to put in the work, enjoy the challenge of winning, and are motivated to succeed in a quota-carrying role with the opportunity to earn commission.
  • Strong communicator — you're confident on the phone, clear in writing, and know how to listen
  • Organised and detail-oriented — you don't let things slip and you take ownership of your pipeline
  • Coachable — you actively seek feedback and apply it quickly
  • Competitive but collaborative — you want to win, and you want your team to win too
  • Some exposure to a sales, customer-facing, or fast-paced commercial environment is a plus
  • Fluency in English is required; additional languages are a bonus

Benefits

At Uncapped, our people make us successful. We're a start-up with big goals — we work hard, and we want to give everyone the benefits they really want. Some of what you can expect:

installation costs)

weights, and expenses.

This is not a single-product role.

You will own three distinct but connected product lines — and make sure they don’t just exist, but actually work together, scale, and win in the market.

  • API Platform (core business, high-impact, revenue-driving)
  • Mobility Platform (IITS) (government-led deployments + enterprise use cases)
  • Navigation Product (Google Maps-based solution)

You’ll sit right in the middle of tech, business, and market reality — translating vision into execution.

What You’ll Own

1. Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Define and drive the roadmap across all three product lines
  • Prioritize features based on real market needs (not internal assumptions)
  • Align product direction with business goals and revenue opportunities

2. Market & Domain Understanding

  • Bring strong exposure to traffic monitoring / mobility / smart city ecosystems
  • Track market trends, competitors, and regulatory shifts (especially in public sector ecosystems)
  • Validate product-market fit continuously through real-world feedback

3. Execution & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Act as the bridge between engineering, business, and stakeholders
  • Translate business requirements into clear product specs and tech requirements
  • Work closely with engineering teams to ensure timely and scalable delivery

4. Stakeholder & Client Engagement

  • Work with government entities, enterprise clients, and internal leadership
  • Handle high-stakes conversations with clarity and confidence
  • Ensure product direction aligns with client expectations and deployment realities

5. Documentation & Communication

  • Own business-level documentation: PRDs, roadmaps, use cases, and proposals
  • Communicate complex ideas in a simple, structured way
  • Bring clarity when things get messy (because they will)

What We’re Looking For

  • 6–10 years in Product Management / Product Leadership
  • Strong experience in traffic monitoring, mobility tech, ITS, or smart city ecosystems
  • Proven ability to manage multiple products simultaneously
  • Experience working with APIs and platform-based products
  • Strong understanding of government or enterprise deployments
  • Excellent communication — both written and verbal
  • Ability to move between strategy and execution without getting lost in either
  • Comfortable working in ambiguity and building structure where none exists

What Will Set You Apart

  • Experience with navigation systems / geospatial products / Google Maps integrations
  • Exposure to public sector projects or smart city initiatives
  • Strong commercial thinking — not just product, but business impact

raw.description:
Symetrahas an exciting new opportunity to join our Benefits Division as a Customer Communications Manager.The person in this role will own the strategy, development, and delivery of customer communications that inform, engage, and build trust with our customers.

About the role

In this role, you will lead customer communications for the Benefits Division. You will partner closely with teams across the organization including, marketing, product, sales, account management, operations, compliance, and legal to deliver clear and accurate messaging that enhances the customer experience.

You will play a key role in translating complex business updates, operational changes, and regulatory requirements into communications that are easy for customers to understand and act on.

What you will do

  • Communication Strategy & Planning
    • Develop and implement communication strategies, processes, and workflows for Benefits customers.
    • Partner with leaders and key stakeholders to prioritize communication needs and align on timelines and deliverables.
    • Ensure customers receive consistent, clear, and timely information across communication channels.
  • Communication Development & Execution
    • Create, edit, and distribute customer-facing communications, including operational updates, service announcements, and regulatory notifications.
    • Manage communication logistics, including audience segmentation, distribution methods, and delivery platforms.
    • Support urgent communication needs related to business, operational, or customer-impacting events.
    • Monitor project timelines and coordinate communication from initiation through distribution.
    • Provide reporting and insights on communication initiatives and outcomes.
  • Governance & Compliance
    • Coordinate review and approval processes with compliance, legal, privacy, brand, and other internal partners.
    • Ensure communications meet regulatory requirements, company standards, and accessibility guidelines.

Why Work at Symetra

Here’s what some of our employees have to say about why they work at Symetra:

“We're big enough to make an impact on the country, but small enough to care and know who you are and what you're contributing to the organization. All new ideas are welcome!” - Stephanie F., VP Customer Service & Operations

"Just do it! Even if you feel like you may not be 100% qualified, apply. Sometimes we see potential in others that they can not see in themselves. You may be over qualified, or you may be the "something special" we are looking for to bring a unique, fresh approach to our company." - Ruby S., Associate EDX Analyst

What we offer you

Benefits and Perks

We don’t take a “one-size-fits-all” approach when it comes to our employees. Our programs are designed to make your life better both at work and at home.

  • Flexible full-time or hybrid telecommuting arrangements
  • Plan for your future with our 401(k) plan and take advantage of immediate vesting and company matching up to 6%
  • Paid time away including vacation and sick time, flex days and ten paid holidays
  • Give back to your community and double your impact through our company matching
  • Want more details? Check out ourSymetra Benefits Overview

Compensation

Salary Range: $106,400 - $177,300 plus eligibility for annual bonus program

Who You Are

  • 8+ years of experience developing and delivering customer, plan member, or client communications required.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, and proofreading skills, with the ability to translate complex information into clear, customer-friendly messaging.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, including the ability to manage multiple communication initiatives simultaneously.
  • Proven ability to build relationships and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders at all levels.
  • Experience supporting communications in a regulated industry, such as insurance, financial services, healthcare, or a similar environment.
  • Knowledge of Group Benefits, Supplemental Health Benefits, and/or Stop Loss insurance products.
  • Experience with Salesforce CRM, email marketing platforms, customer communication platforms, or marketing automation tools.
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards and best practices for customer communications.
  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Ability to travel occasionally to support business needs.

Travel:

Required Training & Professional Development
All newly hired people leaders with direct reports are required to complete a comprehensive leadership development program within their first year. This program includes both virtual and in-person training. The in-person sessions will take place at Symetra’s corporate headquarters in Bellevue, Washington. Symetra covers all travel and accommodation expenses.

Reasonable Accommodations
Symetra is committed to providing equitable access to all job-related responsibilities, including required travel. If reasonable accommodations are needed for travel, Symetra’s HR department will work to provide appropriate solutions in alignment with individual needs and company policies.

We empower inclusion
At Symetra, we aspire to be the most inclusive insurance company in the country. We're building a place where every employee feels valued, respected, and has opportunities to contribute.
Inclusion is about recognizing our assumptions, considering multiple perspective, and removing barriers. We accept and celebrate diverse experiences, identities, and perspectives, because lifting each other up fuels thought and builds a stronger, more innovative company. We invite you to learn more about our efforts here.
Creating a world where more people have access to financial freedom
Symetra is a national financial services company dedicated to helping people achieve their financial goals and feel confident about the future. In our daily work, we're guided by the principles of Value, Transparency and Sustainability. This means we provide products and services people need at a competitive price, we communicate clearly and openly so people understand what they're buying, and we design products--and operate our company--to stand the test of time. We're committed to showing up for our communities, lifting up our employees, and standing up for diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI). Join our team and help us create a world where more people have access to financial freedom.
For more information about our careers visit:
Work Authorization
Employer work visa sponsorship and support are not provided for this role. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States at hire and must maintain authorization to work in the United States throughout their employment with our company.
Please review Symetra's Remote Network Minimum Requirements:
As a remote-first organization committed to providing a positive experience for both employees and customers, Symetra has the following standards for employees' internet connection:
  • Minimum Internet Speed:100 Mbps download and 20 Mbps upload, in alignment with the FCC's definition of "broadband."
  • Internet Type:Fiber, Cable (e.g., Comcast, Spectrum), or DSL.
  • Not Permissible:Satellite (e.g., Starlink), cellular broadband (hotspot or otherwise), any other wireless technology, or wired dial-up.
When applying to jobs at Symetra you'll be asked to test your internet speed and confirm that your internet connection meets or exceeds Symetra's standard as outlined above.

Identity Verification

Symetra is committed to fair and secure hiring practices. For all roles, candidates will be required (after the initial phone screen) to be on video for all interviews. Symetra will take affirmative steps at key points in the process to verify that a candidate is not seeking employment fraudulently, e.g. through use of a false identity.
Failure to comply with verification procedures may result in:
  • Disqualification from the recruitment process
  • Withdrawal of a job offer
  • Termination of employment and other criminal and/or civil remedies, if fraud is discovered

raw.description:
Tailored Brands is a leading specialty retailer of menswear, including suits, formalwear, sportswear, and a broad selection of business casual offerings. Our brandsinclude Men's Wearhouse, Jos. A. Bank, Moores and K&G Fashion Superstore,which offers merchandise for the entire family. We help people love the way they look and feel for their most important moments by delivering personalized products and services through our convenient network of stores and e-commerce sites.

About the Job

We currently have an exciting opportunity for a Lead Product Manager to join our Digital team. A Lead Product Manager operates across multiple product domains, influencing strategy beyond their immediate team. You’ll navigate ambiguity, align leaders and stakeholders around difficult decisions and elevate how product management is practiced across the organization.

What You’ll Do | Key Accountabilities

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, execution, and measurable outcomes across one or more product domains, ensuring roadmaps align with company strategy and deliver measurable customer and business outcomes.
  • Use customer research, analytics, experimentation, and business insight to identify and prioritize the highest-impact opportunities.
  • Lead complex product discovery efforts that span multiple teams, balancing customer value, business objectives, technical feasibility, and organizational priorities.
  • Make high-quality product decisions by synthesizing evidence, weighing tradeoffs, and creating clarity through ambiguity.
  • Partner with Engineering throughout delivery, supporting release planning, experimentation, and post-launch measurement.
  • Build alignment across Product, Engineering, Design, stakeholders, and leadership through thoughtful communication and influence rather than authority.
  • Raise the quality of product management by developing and following reusable frameworks, operating practices, and setting standards that help teams make better product decisions.
  • Champion experimentation and continuous learning, ensuring product investments are measured, validated, and iterated based on customer and business outcomes.
  • Lead AI-native product management by identifying emerging capabilities, developing reusable AI workflows, and helping the organization thoughtfully integrate AI to improve research, decision-making, execution, and operational effectiveness while maintaining accountability for outcomes.

What You’ll Bring | Skills & Experience

  • 12+ years of product management experience delivering customer-facing digital products.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing or another related field preferred.
  • Demonstrated success defining product strategy and delivering measurable customer and business outcomes across complex initiatives or multiple product domains.
  • Exceptional product judgment with the ability to navigate ambiguity, evaluate tradeoffs, and make high-quality strategic decisions.
  • Strong experience defining product strategy, prioritization, experimentation, and roadmaps.
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, make sound product decisions, and influence cross-functional teams.
  • Experience partnering closely with Engineering, Design, senior stakeholders, and senior leadership throughout the product lifecycle.
  • High degree of ownership, accountability, continuous learning, and bias toward action.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing large-scale customer-facing e-commerce or omnichannel digital products.
  • Experience with experimentation platforms and modern product analytics tools such as Heap, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar.
  • Demonstrated curiosity for emerging AI technologies with hands-on experience using AI coding tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar) to prototype ideas, automate workflows, and build lightweight solutions.
  • Experience integrating modern SaaS commerce technologies, including search, personalization, content management, payments, customer engagement, or related platforms.
Please note that you do not need to qualify for all requirements to be considered. We encourage you to apply if you can meet most of the requirements and are comfortable opening a dialog to be considered.

Work Environment, Physical & Mental Demands

  • Ability to sit and work at a computer keyboard for extended periods of time
  • Ability to stoop, kneel, bend at the waist, and reach daily
  • Able to lift and move up to 25 pounds occasionally
  • Must utilize visual acuity, speech and hearing, hand and eye coordination and manual dexterity necessary to operate a computer and office equipment
  • Hours regularly 40 hours per week, as work dictates, in a remote work location.

Benefits

This role is eligible for healthcare including medical, dental and vision, retirement savings (401k with a company match), income protection programs such as life, accident and disability insurance, paid time off for sick leave, vacation, bereavement, jury duty, and holidays, wellbeing program, commuter, adoption assistance, education assistance, legal services, and employee merchandise discounts. For more detailed information go Tailoredbrands.com/working-here/people-culture.

Work-Life Balance

We understand the demands of work, school, family, and personal responsibilities. Through our work-life resources and programs we offer services for every stage of life to help you manage the day-to-day needs. We offer programs such as:
  • Meeting-Free Fridays (encouraged) | so you can catch up on work and self-development
  • Summer Fridays | from Memorial Day to Labor Day so you can enjoy a head-start to the weekend
  • Holiday Early Departure | close out early the business day before a company observed holiday
The starting salary for this position is $141,100 - $180,000. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on factors such as skills, experience, and qualifications. Over time, and subject to performance, tenure, and evolving responsibilities, total compensation for this role may grow to as much as $220,000. Other compensation may include a 10% Annual Incentive Plan (AIP) bonus paid out according to policy. Base pay information is based on market location and may be subject to prevailing wage laws, if applicable.
Note: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities or qualifications associated with this job.
