raw.title: Sr. Scrum Master/Project Manager
raw.excerpt: “Be part of a company that is influential and the standard for a rapidly evolving industry!
raw.description:
“Be part of a company that is influential and the standard for a rapidly evolving industry!”

WHO ARE WE?

RealTime eClinical Solutions is a Global Leader and rapidly growing SaaS technology company that provides comprehensive Software Solutions to the clinical research industry.

Our Vision is to reshape the global clinical research industry with innovative solutions that help advance medicine and save lives. Our cloud-based solutions are dedicated to solving complex problems and simplifying clinical research processes to be more organized, efficient, and cost-effective. We are based out of San Antonio, TX, but are truly a remote and telecommuting company.

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

The Senior Scrum Master / Project Manager is the primary guiding authority for Agile ceremonies, structure, and delivery discipline across the engineering organization. This role sets and enforces the standard for how Agile is practiced organization-wide — directly coaching and overseeing a cohort of Scrum Masters across a broad portfolio of teams, while personally serving as the acting Scrum Master for a subset of teams to stay close to day-to-day delivery. The role owns the organization's Agile Development Metrics & Quality Accountability Framework end-to-end, translating Jira and GitHub activity into trustworthy delivery and quality signals for engineering and business leadership. The Senior Scrum Master / Project Manager is also the primary Agile conduit between Product Management/Product Ownership and the engineering teams, ensuring scaled Agile practices connect roadmap intent to sprint execution cleanly and predictably.

WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?

1. Agile Program Leadership & Scrum Master Coaching

  • Set and enforce the standard for Agile ceremonies and structure across 12 teams; directly coach and performance-support 6–7 Scrum Masters.
  • Maintain a consistent Agile operating model (definitions of ready/done, estimation, cadences, escalation paths) across all teams.
  • Resolve cross-team delivery impediments and run a Scrum Master community of practice.

2. Direct Scrum Mastery

  • Act as Scrum Master for 2 assigned teams — ceremonies, backlog hygiene, and impediment removal — to stay grounded in day-to-day delivery.

3. Agile Development Metrics & Quality Accountability Framework

Own, implement, and evolve a comprehensive Agile Development Metrics & Quality Accountability Framework spanning sprint execution, code review discipline, and defect accountability — from first commit through production — using Jira and GitHub as the systems of record.

  • Implement and maintain core delivery metrics in Jira — velocity, sprint predictability, cycle time, lead time, throughput, WIP, scope creep, and carryover rate — at team, sprint, and rolling-quarter cadence.
  • Implement code review rigor metrics from GitHub pull request activity, including change-requested rate, rework commits per PR, review cycles to approval, time in review, and senior reviewer
  • comment density; partner with engineering leadership to maintain branch protection rules and senior-reviewer group definitions that keep this data complete.
  • Own the defect discovery-by-phase taxonomy on the Bug issue type in Jira (Unit/TDD, Code Review, Dev/Integration Testing, QA/Release Testing, Production/Escaped) and the resulting metrics: defect detection distribution, escape rate, production escape rate, phase containment effectiveness, defect density, and mean time to detect.
  • Maintain the escaped-defect attribution chain, linking each bug ticket back to its originating story/task, the merged pull request(s) that implemented it, and the author and reviewers of record, via Jira links and GitHub smart-commit/PR referencing, enabling accountability rollups in either direction.
  • Own the recurring per-release and quarterly Contractor/Team Accountability Rollup reporting cycle, and ensure trend lines (improving, flat, or worsening) are reviewed with the relevant teams and leads, not just presented in aggregate.
  • Own the reporting and BI delivery mechanic for the framework — including administration of eazyBI (or equivalent BI layer) connected to Jira and GitHub — to produce recurring dashboards and reports for engineering and business stakeholders without requiring a separate data pipeline.
  • Continuously refine the framework's guiding principles: metrics must be actionable, paired for balance (speed vs. quality), system-focused rather than individual-focused (with defect attribution as the narrow, explicitly scoped exception), trend-driven, diagnostic rather than target-driven, and passively instrumented from existing Jira/GitHub workflow artifacts.

4. Agile Conduit for Product Management

  • Serve as the primary Agile conduit between Product Managers, Product Owners, and the engineering organization, translating roadmap and portfolio intent into scaled Agile execution across the 12 teams.
  • Apply scaled Agile methodologies (e.g., SAFe, Scrum@Scale, or the organization's equivalent) to coordinate cross-team dependencies, program increment / release planning, and backlog alignment between Product and Engineering.
  • Facilitate program-level ceremonies (e.g., PI planning, scrum-of-scrums, cross-team dependency reviews) that connect Product Owner intent with the delivery capacity and constraints of the 12 teams.
  • Provide Product Management and Product Ownership with visibility into delivery health and quality signals from the Metrics & Quality Accountability Framework to inform prioritization and roadmap tradeoffs.

PERFORMANCE STANDARDS

Performance at this level is evaluated across four dimensions:

Agile Program Delivery

  • Ceremonies across all 12 teams consistently meet the organization's defined Agile standard, with impediments identified and escalated proactively rather than discovered after the fact.
  • The 2 directly run teams deliver predictably, with healthy sprint predictability and carryover metrics.

Metrics & Quality Accountability

  • The Agile Development Metrics & Quality Accountability Framework remains accurate, current, and trusted — data completeness (linkage, tagging, discovery-phase fields) is maintained across teams.
  • Reporting and BI dashboards are delivered on a reliable cadence and are actively used by engineering and business leadership in decision-making.

Organizational Impact & Coaching

  • Scrum Masters who report into this role demonstrably improve in facilitation quality, impediment resolution, and Agile maturity over time.
  • Escaped-defect and code-review-rigor trends across teams move in a positive direction release over release.

Leadership & Communication

  • Serves as a trusted, low-friction conduit between Product and Engineering, with dependencies and tradeoffs surfaced early rather than at the point of conflict.
  • Communicates delivery risk, quality trends, and program status clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

WHAT DO YOU NEED?

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Project Manager in a professional software development environment, including experience coaching or leading other Scrum Masters.
  • Demonstrated experience running Agile ceremonies and delivery practices across multiple concurrent teams.
  • Working knowledge of scaled Agile methodologies (e.g., SAFe, Scrum@Scale, LeSS) and experience serving as a conduit between Product Management/Product Ownership and engineering teams.
  • Hands-on proficiency administering Jira for Agile delivery, including custom fields, workflows, and sprint/board configuration.
  • Working knowledge of GitHub pull request workflows, branch protection, and Jira–GitHub linkage (smart commits) sufficient to own a metrics framework built on that data.
  • Demonstrated ability to design, implement, and evolve delivery and quality metrics programs, and to translate them into reporting that non-technical stakeholders can act on.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tooling and workflows.

WHAT SETS YOU APART?

  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or equivalent certification; SAFe certification (e.g., SAFe Scrum Master, SAFe Program Consultant) a plus.
  • Direct experience administering eazyBI (or a comparable BI/reporting layer) against Jira and GitHub data.
  • Experience building or maturing a defect discovery and escaped-defect attribution framework.
  • Experience working in regulated environments with compliance requirements (HIPAA, HITECH, PCI DSS, or similar).

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU?

  • The company sponsors health insurance, long-term disability, and life insurance.
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off.
  • 10 paid Holidays.
  • Paid Parental Leave.
  • Work Anniversary Bonus.
  • Participation in the Employee of the Quarter Program.
  • Monthly $100 Connectivity Stipend Reimbursement.
  • RealTime matches employee 401K contributions at 100% of the first 3% invested and 50% of the next 2% invested.

All successful candidates must complete and pass reference and background checks.

The desired salary must be indicated for the application to be considered.

The pay rate is commensurate with experience and is determined on an individual basis after an interview has occurred.

Equal Opportunity Employer – RealTime eClinical Solutions strongly values diversity and is committed to equal opportunity and non-discrimination in all of its policies and practices, including employment.

Your Right to Work – In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility.

Thank you for your interest in RealTime eClinical Solutions.

Arcadis jest wiodącą na świecie firmą dostarczającą zrównoważone rozwiązania w zakresie projektowania, inżynierii oraz konsultingu dla zasobów naturalnych i obiektów budowlanych.

Jesteśmy zespołem ponad 34 000 osób w ponad 30 krajach, których wspólnym celem jest poprawa jakości życia. Każdy z nas odgrywa ważną rolę. Dzięki sile wielu ciekawych umysłów możemy wspólnie rozwiązywać najbardziej złożone wyzwania świata i tworzyć jeszcze większy wpływ.

PROJECT PLANNER

lokalizacja: cała Polska

Zakres obowiązków:

  • Sporządzenie oraz nadzór nad harmonogramem projektu począwszy od fazy uzyskiwania pozwoleń administracyjnych, poprzez prowadzenie robót budowlanych, oraz odbiory techniczne i urzędowe.
  • Nadzór nad harmonogramem dostaw, montażu, testów i uruchomienia instalacji technologicznych.
  • Monitorowanie terminów dostaw kluczowych urządzeń oraz analiza ich wpływu na harmonogram projektu.
  • Inicjowanie i wdrażanie działań naprawczych w celu realizacji projektu w założonych ramach czasowych.
  • Sporządzanie raportów tygodniowych oraz miesięcznych, uczestnictwo w spotkaniach z koordynacyjnych z wykonawcami robót oraz inwestorem.
  • Aktywne wsparcie kierownika projektu oraz zespołu inspektorów nadzoru w zakresie terminowości prowadzonych robót.

Kwalifikacje i doświadczenie:

  • Wykształcenie wyższe techniczne; budownictwo lub pokrewne.
  • Praktyczna znajomość zależności harmonogramowych pomiędzy robotami budowlanymi, elektrycznymi oraz instalacją i uruchomieniem urządzeń technologicznych.
  • Co najmniej dwuletnie doświadczenie zawodowe w pełnieniu funkcji planisty w branży budowlanej przy realizacji projektów budowlanych, doświadczenie w realizacji projektów przemysłowych, energetycznych, infrastrukturalnych lub magazynów energii będzie dużym atutem.
  • Praktyczna wiedza z zakresu planowania procesów produkcyjnych, oraz zrozumienie zależności pomiędzy poszczególnymi branżami budowlanymi w trakcie prowadzenia robót budowlanych.
  • Dobra znajomość języka polskiego i angielskiego również w zakresie słownictwa budowlanego, umożliwiająca swobodną komunikację oraz pisanie raportów technicznych w tym języku.
  • Bardzo dobra znajomość programu MS Project oraz pakietu MS Office
  • Umiejętność pracy w zespole oraz wysokie umiejętności organizacyjne i interpersonalne.
  • Duża motywacja i zaangażowanie w wykonywaną pracę.
  • Prawo jazdy kat. B oraz mobilność.

Dlaczego Arcadis?

Możemy osiągać nasze cele wyłącznie wtedy, gdy każdy ma przestrzeń, by być najlepszą wersją siebie. Wierzymy, że wkład każdego pracownika ma znaczenie. Dlatego jako jedni z pionierów rozwijamy podejście oparte na kompetencjach, które umożliwia wykorzystanie unikalnego doświadczenia i wiedzy do kształtowania własnej kariery oraz maksymalizowania wpływu, jaki możemy wywierać razem.

W Arcadis wykonujesz pracę, która ma znaczenie — niezależnie od stanowiska przyczyniasz się do tworzenia zrównoważonych rozwiązań na rzecz bardziej prosperującej planety. Zostaw swój ślad: w swojej karierze, wśród współpracowników, u klientów, w swoim życiu i w świecie, który nas otacza. Razem możemy stworzyć trwałe dziedzictwo.

Dołącz do Arcadis. Twórz Dziedzictwo.

Nasze zobowiązanie w zakresie Równości, Różnorodności, Inkluzywności i Przynależności

Chcemy, abyś każdego dnia mógł/mogła wnosić do pracy to, co najlepsze — dlatego traktujemy równość bardzo poważnie i rozliczamy się z naszych działań. Naszą ambicją jest być pracodawcą z wyboru i zapewniać doskonałe miejsce pracy wszystkim naszym ludziom

Wierzymy, że różnorodne zespoły, łączące osoby o odmiennych doświadczeniach, tworzą najbardziej innowacyjne idee. Równość, różnorodność i inkluzja są kluczowymi elementami naszej misji poprawy jakości życia — realizujemy je wspólnie w ramach sześciu obszarów ED&I: Wiek, Niepełnosprawność, Wiara, Płeć, LGBT+ oraz Rasa. Zróżnicowany i wysoko wykwalifikowany zespół jest niezbędny do naszego sukcesu.

Przedział wynagrodzenia dla tego stanowiska wynosi 11'741 - 17'600 PLN brutto.

Somos a Adtail, uma agência de marketing digital feita de pessoas apaixonadas por inovar com colaboração, parceria e transparência. Somos muito mais do que performance, somos uma empresa feita de pessoas admiradoras da inovação. Somos certificados pela GPTW, e atuamos buscando os melhores resultados a partir da comunicação, alto desempenho e inovação. Com 200 Adtails trabalhamos em um ambiente tecnológico, dinâmico e diverso, com propósito de autodesenvolvimento voltado para as melhores estratégias do marketing digital.

Somos Diversos e Plurais!

Sabemos da importância da pluralidade e diversidade, pensando nisso, o Projeto Plural foi desenvolvido para que as pessoas sejam exatamente quem são, sem qualquer distinção, e que tenham segurança para atuarem em um ambiente acolhedor, que trabalha com foco no bem estar e saúde mental.

Incentivamos que você se inscreva diretamente nas oportunidades de seu interesse, porém, se vocênão identificouuma vaga em aberto que tenha a ver com o seu perfil, neste banco de talentos você pode conhecer as áreas de atuação da Adtail e deixar o seu cadastro para futuras oportunidades!

Áreas de atuação da Adtail:

Essas são as soluções que oferecemos para nossos clientes(é importante que você leia atentamente sobre cada área, e no momento de sua candidatura sinalize em qual time deseja atuar):

Planejamento- Atuação com planejamento de negócio, analisando o cenário da empresa e do mercado, realizando um diagnóstico dos canais de vendas, identificando oportunidades e ameaças e trazendo sugestões de melhorias.

CRM- Atuação com estratégias de relacionamento com os clientes como segmentação de bases, disparos de e-mails personalizados e estudos estratégicos para impactar potenciais compras e melhorar as taxas de conversão para vendas.

Inbound- Atuação com construção do funil de marketing e vendas para empresas que estão desenvolvendo sua maturidade digital, utilizando estratégias do Inbound para acelerar o processo de vendas de negócios.

Social Media- Atuação com criação de conteúdo para redes sociais com foco em divulgar a marca da empresa cliente e transformar seguidores em clientes. Também atua comdefinição de estratégias de branding, orientação de produção publicitária, imagem da marca e todo o suporte necessário para a melhor veiculação de campanhas para aumentar o impacto do negócio.

Criação- Atuação com criações de Banners, layouts, e-mail marketing, imagens para posts e muitos outros materiais para destacar a marca do cliente nos meios digitais.

Data- Atuação com serviços que apoiam o cliente aumentando o acesso aos dados, com relatórios personalizados e análises avançadas baseadas em algoritmos, tudo focado em trazer mais performance para o cliente.

Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)- Atuação com estratégias baseada no aprimoramento de elementos de websites, otimizando a taxa de conversão e tornando o processo de venda mais eficiente.

Tagging -Atuação com implementação de ferramentas para mensurar o desempenho de sites, além de integração entre plataformas.

Tech-Atuação com desenvolvimento de sites, blogs, Landing Pages e muitas outras páginas da web com foco em melhoria de conversões.

Recruiter: Kira Charytoniuk

Senior Field Clinical Engineer - Talent Pool

(Remote with up to 50% travel; desired candidate'ss location: Prague, Czech Republic)

Please note- this is only an opportunity to join our Talent Comunity, it is not linked to a specific vacancy.

About This Role

At Boston Scientific, your work helps advance innovative cardiac technologies that improve patients’ lives. As a Senior Field Clinical Engineer, you will play a key, hands-on role in supporting both pre- and post-market clinical trials, working directly with leading cardiac centers in Czechia and across Europe.

This role is ideal for someone who values autonomy, ownership, and close collaboration with clinicians. You will be responsible for the day-to-day execution of clinical trial activities at assigned sites, acting as a trusted clinical and technical partner for investigators and hospital teams. The position offers strong visibility within an international clinical organization and exposure to European-level clinical programs.

The role is based in the Czech Republic and requires regular travel within Czechia and across Europe to support clinical activities.

Work mode: Remote, with up to 50% travel.

The Opportunity:

In this role, you will serve as a key clinical interface between Boston Scientific and investigational sites. You will support studies from early site engagement through patient enrollment and follow-up, directly contributing to study quality, patient safety, and the successful development of future cardiac therapies.

You will work independently in the field while remaining closely connected to a collaborative, international clinical team.

What You Will Do:

  • Own the day-to-day execution of clinical trials within your assigned territory, ensuring sites are prepared, supported, and engaged throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for investigators and site staff, providing clinical, technical, and procedural expertise.
  • Support site qualification, initiation, and enrollment readiness activities, including IRB support and investigator training.
  • Deliver hands-on technical support during electrophysiology (EP) procedures and follow-up visits, working directly in cath lab and clinical environments.
  • Build trusted, long-term relationships with physicians and clinical teams, supporting sustained engagement in clinical programs.
  • Lead clinical initiatives and projects, contributing to continuous improvement of study execution and site performance.
  • Collaborate closely with internal clinical, regulatory, and commercial stakeholders to ensure aligned and effective trial delivery.

What You Bring:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Clinical Engineering, or a related scientific or technical discipline.
  • Experience in the medical device industry, clinical research, field clinical engineering, sales support, or as a cardiac physiologist.
  • Hands-on experience in electrophysiology (EP) ablation procedures.
  • Ability to work independently in a field-based role, with a proactive and collaborative mindset.
  • Strong communication skills and confidence working directly with physicians and clinical stakeholders.
  • Willingness to travel up to 50%, including international travel within Europe.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with EP mapped ablation procedures
  • Familiarity with clinical trial operations, site management, and clinical documentation

What We Offer:

At Boston Scientific, we support our employees both professionally and personally. In this role, you can expect:

  • Private medical care, lunch card and life insurance
  • Annual performance-based bonus
  • Company car or car allowance to support frequent travel within Czechia and across Europe
  • Flexible working model with a remote setup and autonomy in organizing your field activities
  • Continuous learning and development opportunities, including technical training, clinical education, and participation in international projects
  • Collaboration within a highly skilled, international clinical team across Europe
  • The opportunity to work closely with leading hospitals and physicians while supporting clinical programs across Czechia and other European countries
  • A company culture focused on innovation, ethics, and meaningful patient impact

Requisition ID:625270

As a leader in medical science for more than 40 years, we are committed to solving the challenges that matter most – united by a deep caring for human life. Our mission to advance science for life is about transforming lives through innovative medical solutions that improve patient lives, create value for our customers, and support our employees and the communities in which we operate. Now more than ever, we have a responsibility to apply those values to everything we do – as a global business and as a global corporate citizen.

So, choosing a career with Boston Scientific (NYSE: BSX) isn’t just business, it’s personal. And if you’re a natural problem-solver with the imagination, determination, and spirit to make a meaningful difference to people worldwide, we encourage you to apply and look forward to connecting with you!

raw.description:
“Be part of an influential company that is the standard for a rapidly evolving industry!”

WHO ARE WE?

RealTime eClinical Solutions is a Global Leader and rapidly growing SaaS technology company that provides comprehensive Software Solutions to the clinical research industry.

Our Vision is to reshape the global clinical research industry with innovative solutions that help advance medicine and save lives. Our cloud-based solutions are dedicated to solving complex problems and simplifying clinical research processes to be more organized, efficient, and cost-effective. We are based in San Antonio, TX, but we are truly a remote and telecommuting company.

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

As a Customer Success Manager (CSM) at RealTime, you will be the primary point of contact for our most strategic customers, ensuring they maximize the value of our eClinical software. You will be responsible for driving customer satisfaction, retention, and growth by providing expert guidance, proactive support, and strategic insights.

This position involves building strong relationships with key stakeholders to understand their needs and delivering tailored solutions that align with their clinical trial objectives. The CSM role also collaborates with RealTime, working closely with business development, professional services, product, and support teams to ensure client partnerships are running smoothly and delivering high impact.

A successful CSM is proactive in new user outreach and relationship development. This includes actively seeking introductions to new client employees, understanding their roles and responsibilities, and identifying the tools and applications they currently use in their work.

WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?

Customer Relationship Management:

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders within assigned accounts.
  • Conduct regular proactive meetings with customers to understand challenges, keep abreast of team and organizational changes, and drive plans and actions that improve adoption and customer value
  • Develop close, highly credible working relationships with stakeholders and decision-makers, achieving status as a trusted advisor based on your product expertise and a demonstrated ability to understand and address customer needs and clinical research business operations
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all customer-related inquiries and escalations.
  • Support comprehensive training and resources to users, tailored to their specific needs and workflows.

Customer Success Strategy:

  • Understand the clinical trial objectives and business goals of each key account.
  • Develop and execute customized success plans that drive customer engagement and satisfaction.
  • Monitor customer usage and proactively address any issues or areas for improvement.

Product Expertise and Support:

  • Gain deep knowledge of RealTime’s eClinical software.
  • Provide expert guidance and best practices to help customers optimize their use of the software.
  • Collaborate with the support team to resolve technical issues and ensure timely responses.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Work closely with sales, products, and support teams to address client needs, escalate issues or product feedback, or otherwise advocate for the customer.
  • Communicate customer feedback and insights to the product team for continuous improvement.
  • Identify opportunities for upselling and expansion within key accounts.

Reporting and Analysis:

  • Track and report on metrics and KPIs, including usage, satisfaction, CSQLs, and renewal rates.
  • Analyze data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for account growth.
  • Prepare and present reports to internal stakeholders and customers as needed.
  • Manage and Track Customer Health, Success Plans, Account touchpoints, etc. via CRM and Customer Success tools.

WHAT DO YOU NEED?

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field (e.g., Life Sciences, Business, Information Technology) or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or a related role within the clinical trials or healthcare software industry.
  • Strong understanding of clinical trial operations and regulations.
  • Proven track record of managing and growing strategic accounts.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills – comfortable communicating with stakeholders of varied backgrounds and levels of seniority, with the ability to adapt style accordingly.
  • Adept at turning qualitative and quantitative data into compelling stories.
  • Experienced in analyzing data and presenting compelling presentations in Quarterly Business Reviews
  • Ability to understand complex software and technical concepts.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce and a desire to learn new technologies that support our client-partner relationships.
  • A detail-driven project manager with strong planning and implementation skills, such that nothing ever falls through the cracks. PMP a plus
  • Able to manage highly complex projects and changing priorities for multiple customers with precision and speed.
  • Experience working for a high-growth SaaS business is preferred.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Gainsight knowledge a plus
  • Ability to travel is needed to meet with key accounts (up to 15%)

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU?

  • The company sponsors health insurance, long-term disability, and life policy
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off
  • 10 paid Holidays
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Work Anniversary Bonus
  • Participation in the Employee of the Quarter Program
  • Monthly $100 Connectivity Stipend Reimbursement
  • RealTime matches employee 401K contributions at 100% of the first 3% invested and 50% of the next 2% invested.

All successful candidates must complete and pass reference and background checks.

The desired salary must be indicated for the application to be considered.

The pay rate is commensurate with experience and is determined on an individual basis after an interview has occurred.

Equal Opportunity Employer – RealTime eClinical Solutions strongly values diversity and is committed to equal opportunity and non-discrimination in all of its policies and practices, including employment.

Your Right to Work – In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility.

Thank you for your interest in RealTime eClinical Solutions.

About BEES

Join us to build the future of B2B commerce!

BEES is AB InBev’s B2B platform. Through our ecosystem, merchants and retailers across 29 countries can stock their businesses quickly, easily, and securely.

At BEES, we dream big, lead with purpose, and develop technology that transforms the way retailers and sellers grow.

Every line of code and every partnership is built in service of a single mission: to make commerce better for retailers and sellers around the world. Here, your work is not just important. It makes a difference!

What you will do

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Java and Spring Boot;
  • Contribute to the evolution of microservices architecture, ensuring performance, resilience, and maintainability;
  • Develop and optimize RESTful APIs and integrations across distributed systems;
  • Improve system observability, monitoring, and logging;
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable solutions aligned with business needs;
  • Participate in technical discussions, architecture decisions, and continuous improvement initiatives;
  • Follow engineering best practices, including code quality, testing, and automation;
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, deployment processes, and cloud-native environments;
  • Support containerized applications using technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.

We are looking for people with:

  • University degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, Systems Analysis and Development, or related fields;
  • Intermediate or Advanced skills in English, both written and oral;
  • Solid backend development experience with Java;
  • Experience designing and maintainingRESTful APIs and microservices;
  • Experience developing and scaling high-throughput and distributed applications;
  • Experience with application monitoring and observability tools such as New Relic, Datadog, or similar platforms;
  • Experience with DevOps and cloud-native tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, Azure, or similar technologies;
  • Experience working in Agile environments;
  • Strong fundamentals in object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, and problem solving;
  • Hands-on experience with Spring Framework technologies such as Spring Boot, Spring Security, and Spring MVC;
  • Knowledge of design patterns, software architecture, and development best practices;
  • Experience with software testing concepts, including unit, integration, regression, stress, and test automation;
  • Intermediate English communication skills, both written and spoken.

Who should apply?

  • You´re passionate about software development and knows how to ensure its quality;
  • You´re motivated by building up world class solutions that impacts millions of users all over the world;
  • You´re creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

Pediatric Radiology Alliance has been in practice for 20 years reading 100% pediatric teleradiology and has been the number one pediatric teleradiology service in the USA during this era. PRA is currently a group of approximately 20 full or part-time CAQ subspecialty pediatric radiologists who work together in a collegial manner. Most of these fine radiologists have been part of our team for many years. PRA currently provides teleradiology coverage in these states: AZ, CO, CT, KY, IL, IN, NE, NY, NV, TN, VA servicing nationally regarded children's hospitals.
The Practice President is a dynamic physician leader responsible for the overall clinical performance, strategic direction, financial performance, and long-term success of the Practice. This leader serves as the primary advocate for Local Practice’s long-term interests, ensuring that decisions and actions align with Radiology Partners’ mission, values, and strategic priorities.
As both a clinical leader and culture bearer, the Practice President fosters a collaborative, high-performance environment focused on excellence in patient care, innovation, physician engagement, and fiscal responsibility. The Practice President represents both the Local Practice and Radiology Partners as a national practice and serves as a key partner to operational leadership in advancing practice performance.
PRACTICE PRESIDENT - POSITION SUMMARY:
  • Serve as the primary advocate for the Practice’s mission, values, and strategic priorities, modeling behaviors aligned with Radiology Partners’ ITESA values (Integrity, Teamwork, Excellence, Service, Accountability).
  • Foster a collaborative, engaged, and supportive physician culture that promotes professional growth, physician satisfaction, and clinical excellence.
  • Be able to maintain the partnership with onsite practice leaders (chiefs of radiology or their designees and lay administrative directors) at our client facilities, adapting to their internal practice routines, being a part of the onsite team while working remotely.
  • Lead regular Practice-wide meetings to strengthen relationships, promote transparency, and reinforce alignment around key initiatives.
  • Champion the differentiated value of being part of Radiology Partners, fostering strong connections within the Local Practice and across the broader RP network.
  • Lead or designate leadership for recruitment efforts to attract top radiology talent aligned with the practice’s clinical and cultural standards.

Radiology Partners has multiple facilities that could use pediatric teleradiology support, and recruitment of a much larger assemblage of readers will be supported, with overnight teleradiologists being of particular importance.
  • Foster a supportive practice environment that encourages retention, engagement, and professional development.
  • Ensure physicians clearly understand how compensation structures align with practice goals and individual performance.
  • Oversee clinical operations to ensure the highest standards of patient care, safety, and diagnostic quality.
  • Implement and champion Best Practice Recommendations (BPRs) and other clinical standards.
  • Monitor and communicate key clinical performance metrics (including MIPS, peer review, and other quality indicators).
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance clinical capacity, accuracy, and quality.
  • Ensure clients receive exceptional clinical and operational service, emphasizing responsiveness, communication, and reliability.
  • Complete QA review of client-initiated exams and participate in peer review committee meetings. Disseminate learning opportunities to all our radiologists, especially when instructive cases occur.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with hospital partners, referring physicians, and healthcare stakeholders.
  • Lead and collaborate the clinical quality program
  • Address client feedback promptly and proactively, striving to exceed expectations and strengthen partnerships.
  • Implement mechanisms to capture and act on client feedback to improve service delivery.
  • Lead local execution of national RP initiatives, ensuring alignment with enterprise priorities and timelines.
  • Champion the adoption of enterprise tools and workflows that improve clinical outcomes, increase capacity, and enhance operational efficiency.
  • Ensure radiologists receive appropriate training and support to effectively leverage new technologies that improve workflow and practice satisfaction.
  • Lead the practice in achieving annual financial targets, including revenue performance, cost management, and overall practice sustainability.
  • Collaborate with operational leadership to develop and execute strategic plans that balance short-term operational needs with long-term growth.
  • Regularly review financial performance and use data-driven insights to optimize practice operations and resource allocation.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

POSITION SUMMARY

Radiology Associates of Florida is excited to open a new remote overnight diagnostic radiology position to add to our growing team in emergency radiology.

Job Details:

  • 7 on 14 off schedule
  • Shift hours: Flexible start times starting at 9pm EST
  • W2 or 1099 options

What You Can Expect:

  • Case mix: Bread-and-butter emergency radiology, including trauma and strokes
  • No mammography required
  • MosaicOS™ is RP’s next-generation operating system for imaging. It’s a cloud-based, AI-native platform that brings everything a radiologist uses into one seamless environment. Instead of jumping between disconnected systems, your reporting, viewing, worklists and AI tools live in one place.
  • Internal moonlighting opportunities – read as much or as little as you prefer
  • Work tailored to your strengths, with subspecialty radiologist support available
  • Strong relationships with referring physicians and consistent clinical exposure to a defined group of facilities

We have crafted this role to have the convenience of a teleradiologist position with the stability, teamwork, and quality of a premier hybrid academic-private practice. While you will have the convenience of working from home, you will develop a relationship with your referring physicians and radiologist colleagues as you service a limited set of clients rather than a sprawling network across multiple time zones. This team of radiologists will work together, so no single radiologist will be working without support, even at night.

Not only will you be working with some of the best radiologists, but the practice will be providing you with Remote Radiology Assistants to improve your workflow and job satisfaction. They will make sure cases are ready for your interpretation by making sure all images and prior studies are available. They will prepare your report templates with filled-in contrast doses, prior reports, and numerical measurements. This will minimize non-clinical distractions and data entry tasks.

We enjoy a state-of-the-art unified PACS software suite that aggregates all our sites onto one smart worklist, which distributes cases intelligently based on your workload and areas of expertise. Built into PACS are convenient collaboration tools that make it easy to share cases and consult with colleagues remotely as it would be in a communal reading room. There are also built-in communication tools to reach our 24/7 radiology assistant concierges and IT support, minimizing your need to pick up the phone. We also have a growing suite of artificial intelligence support tools to automatically handle repetitive tasks like searching for evidence-based guidelines, and free access to point-of-care decision support solutions.

We offer competitive pay with bonus opportunities and abundant 100%-voluntary per-click moonlighting on your off weeks. Expect a full suite of benefits and pre-tax salary deductions for education and business expenses. Our dedicated staff will handle all licensing and credentialing needs.

LOCAL PRACTICE AND COMMUNITY OVERVIEW

RAF is a leading radiology practice in Florida. We serve the most prestigious, established health systems in the state, including on the east and west coasts, the Florida Panhandle, and the Keys. Our scale affords our practice stability and affords our radiologists flexibility in study mix and scheduling. We also recognize that scale alone does not beget excellence. We are quality-oriented, and we practice radiology at the cutting edge, encouraging subspecialty-level interpretations across the practice, and facilitating collaboration and consultation between our radiologists.

Our state-of-the-art IT suite includes universal PACS across the practice, AI tools, and integrated doc-to-doc communication widgets. Mosaic Reporting™ uses ambient AI and large language models (LLMs) to structure reports as you speak naturally. You can dictate as if you’re teaching a fellow. Just describe what you see, and Mosaic builds the structured report automatically, even inserting normal findings for you.

Our practice is locally and democratically led, with decisions vested in the hands of the group at large, rather than in a few founders or a small group of shareholders. We are the teaching physicians for the University of South Florida Department of Radiology in Tampa. In Sarasota, our physicians’ staff the Florida State University College of Medicine, hosting medical students in their 3rd and 4th years. We also invite residents from the FSU Internal Medicine and Emergency Medicine Residency programs to rotate in our departments.

Our diverse group of radiologists work and socialize together in our communities around Florida. Even between our communities across the state, we are one practice. We look forward to letting you get to know us better!

Get to know our practice!

DESIRED PROFESSIONAL SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Candidates must be a Doctor of Medicine or Osteopathy and residency trained in the practice of Diagnostic Radiology
  • Board eligible or certified by the American Board of Radiology or the American Osteopathic Board of Radiology
  • Candidates with fellowship training in any sub-specialty will be considered in addition to non-fellowship trained General Radiologists
  • Medical license or the ability to obtain a license in the state of FL
  • Fellows and residents welcome to apply

COMPENSATION:

Real Estate Sales Agent

The voice that turns a quiet client database into real conversations about buying or selling.

Sector

Real Estate — US-based.

Reports to

Real Estate Agent

Type

Full-time

Hours

Full overlap with Pacific Time required

Rate

$4–$6/hr USD - DOE

Location

Fully remote

Tools

Contact list (previously used Follow Up Boss and RealGeeks), email, SMS/text platform, Facebook, Instagram

Role Overview

This role reactivates our client's existing database of past clients, referrals, and leads through email, text, and social media outreach — generating renewed interest in buying or selling a home. The Real Estate Sales Executive does not close deals; they generate and qualify interest, then hand off warm conversations to the agents for closing.

Key Responsibilities

Database Outreach & Reactivation

  • Send emails and text messages to contacts in the client's database to reopen the conversation about buying or selling
  • Track outreach activity: who was contacted, who responded, and who needs follow-up
  • Personalize outreach based on each contact's history (past client, old lead, referral)

Social Media Outreach

  • Reach out to relevant contacts via Facebook and Instagram messages
  • Identify and engage people showing buying or selling signals on social platforms
  • Keep messaging warm and personal — this is relationship reactivation, not cold advertising

Lead Qualification & Handoff

  • Identify when a contact shows genuine interest in buying or selling
  • Log conversation context clearly so the agents can pick it up without missing anything
  • Hand off qualified conversations promptly so momentum isn't lost

Tracking & Reporting

  • Keep a simple, current record of outreach activity and responses
  • Flag which messages get replies and which contacts are warming up

Who Will Succeed

This role is steady, repetitive, and relationship-driven. The person who thrives here doesn't get discouraged by silence or 'no' — they stay warm, consistent, and genuinely curious about people.

  • You're comfortable with repetitive outreach and don't take non-responses personally
  • You write and message in a natural, warm tone — never scripted or salesy
  • You're organized — nothing you send or hear back goes untracked
  • You're comfortable on social media and know how to message people without feeling like a stranger
  • You use AI tools to draft and personalize outreach faster, without losing the human touch
  • You know the difference between generating interest and closing a deal — and you're energized by the first part

    Experience & Skills
  • Required: Some familiarity with real estate concepts (buying/selling process, what a lead or database contact looks like) — not necessarily an expert
  • Required: Some experience with outreach, ISA (inside sales), or lead generation work — cold or warm outreach experience counts
  • Required: Strong written English — emails, texts, and DMs represent the client directly; writing is assessed at screening
  • Required: AI expertise — genuinely skilled with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) for drafting, personalizing, and speeding up outreach; this is a real capability, not casual use, and will be assessed
  • Required: Full overlap with Pacific Time required — not partial coordination
  • Required: Comfortable managing outreach across multiple channels (email, SMS, Facebook, Instagram) at once

    -Preferred:     Prior experience with a real estate CRM or database system

-Preferred: Comfortable managing outreach across multiple channels (email, SMS, Facebook, Instagram) at once

Who We Are

Modern enterprises run their most critical applications in complex, cloud-native environments, and the threats keep multiplying: outages, ransomware, bad actors, human error. Most disaster recovery tools stop at backing up data. We’ve built the next generation of cloud resiliency and disaster recovery for AWS with an automated, application-aware platform that recovers a company's entire application stack, not isolated resources, in under an hour. We protect production workloads for enterprises that cut across multiple industries like healthcare, financial services, and SaaS — the kind of companies that can't afford downtime.

At Arpio, we believe great companies are built by people who take ownership, move with urgency, and consistently deliver results. We just closed our $15M Series A to expand into new clouds and build out our roadmap, which means we're growing the team right now, and your work will directly shape where we go next.

This isn't simply another job. It's an opportunity to help build a company.

About the Role

As a Pre-Sales Solutions Architect at Arpio, you will play a pivotal role in our Go-to-Market team. This dynamic and rewarding position requires a mix of technical expertise, cloud infrastructure passion, and sales acumen. You will engage in both pre-sales and post-sales processes, collaborating closely with our account team to convert opportunities into success stories.

In this role, you will serve as the technical lead between clients, partners, and our internal teams. You will be responsible for working alongside the sales team in delivering Proof of Concept (POC) engagements through the entire sales cycle; helping prospects understand not just what Arpio does, but why it is the right answer for their specific AWS environment.

We move fast, hold ourselves accountable to outcomes, and treat every customer relationship as something worth protecting. If you are energized by solving hard technical problems, thrive in ambiguity, and want to help build a function from the ground up, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Do

Pre-Sales & Deal Execution

  • Contribute to regional sales, POC, and GTM strategy alongside New Logo and Strategic Growth AEs
  • Discover and create prospect-specific, quantifiable value statements that directly impact deals, translating RTO/RPO gaps, downtime costs, and ransomware exposure into business cases that resonate with both technical and economic buyers
  • Lead product demonstrations and POC engagements end-to-end, tailored to each prospect's AWS environment and resilience requirements
  • Respond to RFPs, security questionnaires, and enterprise procurement documentation with accuracy and speed

Customer & Partner Engagement

  • Listen first. Understand the customer's problem deeply before proposing a solution; respond quickly and communicate proactively throughout every evaluation
  • Develop and maintain working relationships with AWS and Azure field teams to support co-sell motions
  • Travel regionally to client sites as required

Internal Collaboration & Enablement

  • Work closely with Account Executives and internal stakeholders across product, marketing, and customer success
  • Feed technical insights, product gaps, and competitive intelligence back to product and engineering. Your field observations shape our roadmap
  • Help build the solutions engineering playbook from the ground up; your patterns become the foundation for future SE hires
  • Be a reliable member of the team, providing coverage and support to customers and peers when needed

How We Work

At Arpio, we care about the outcome as much as the effort it took to get there. We take initiative, follow through, and report back on what we learned along the way. That same instinct shows up in how we treat customers and each other: we respond quickly, speak honestly and openly, and trust our teammates to take direct feedback as a chance to grow. We move like a startup because we are one, spending wisely and treating every dollar and every customer like they matter, because they do. If that's how you like to work, you'll fit in well here. For this role, that looks like:

  • You prepare before every call. You know the prospect’s stack, their likely concerns, and what a successful POC looks like before you join the meeting
  • You are honest about what the product can and cannot do. Your credibility with technical buyers is your most valuable asset — you don’t oversell
  • You own the outcome. You track your own work, identify risks early, and ask for help before it’s too late
  • You execute with urgency and diligence, every customer, every deal, and every day counts
  • You share what you learn. Wins, losses, and near-misses all make the team better when knowledge isn’t siloed
  • You assume positive intent in interactions with colleagues and customers, and you welcome direct feedback as an opportunity to grow
  • You are comfortable with the ambiguity of an early-stage company and energized by the chance to shape how things are done

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years in a pre-sales, solutions engineering, or technical sales role in B2B SaaS
  • Hands-on experience with AWS. You understand how these environments are architected, not just how to talk about them
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical evaluations and POCs from scoping through completion in enterprise or upper mid-market accounts
  • Strong technical depth in one or more of: cloud infrastructure, disaster recovery, backup and recovery, cybersecurity, data protection, or ransomware resilience
  • Ability to consult at all levels - C-suite, infrastructure leads, security teams, procurement, and finance
  • Experience presenting technical cloud solutions to clients and channel partners
  • Proven ability to complete RFPs, security questionnaires, and enterprise procurement documentation
  • Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills
  • Ability to work as part of a team in an innovative and fast-paced startup environment while delivering to deadlines
  • Passion for staying current with cloud infrastructure and DR trends, and a willingness to continuously develop your skillset

Salary and Benefits

  • Competitive salary + Equity
  • Arpio will cover 100% of your personal medical premiums, 100% of your life insurance premium, and 75% of your personal premiums for vision and dental (because the insurance companies won’t let us pay 100%). For your dependents, Arpio will cover 75% of medical, dental, and vision premiums. No life insurance is included.
  • For fully remote employees, a $125 home office stipend or $250 company-subsidized co-working membership
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Small, collaborative team environment
  • Opportunity to work on the cutting edge of cloud technology

Arpio is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive workplace, and we welcome applicants of all backgrounds. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We provide reasonable accommodations to applicants and employees with disabilities; if you need an accommodation during the application or interview process, let us know.

raw.description:
MTSI is currently seeking to hire a Financial System Analyst to join our Finance team.
This role is 100% remote.

Overview

We are seeking an accomplished technology leader with deep expertise in Deltek Costpoint, enterprise system integrations (including SAP/HR, ADP and Workday Adaptive), and advanced SQL/PL-SQL development. This senior-level role is responsible for defining technical architecture, integration strategy, and data governance framework supporting mission-critical financial, HR, and business operational processes. The Financial System Analyst will drive long-term modernization initiatives, ensure data integrity across the enterprise ecosystem, and provide strategic guidance to technical teams and business stakeholders. The ideal candidate excels at translating business requirements into efficient, scalable technical solutions while maintaining system stability, data accuracy, and process automation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the architectural design, roadmap planning, and governance for Costpoint and its integrations with enterprise systems.
  • Serve as the highest-level technical authority for Costpoint configurations, data models, security design, workflows, and custom solutions.
  • Design, build, and maintain integrations between Costpoint and internal/external systems (HRIS, financial systems, procurement tools, data warehouses, etc.). Architect scalable, secure integration frameworks using APIs, middleware, ETL pipelines, and event-driven processes.
  • Develop SQL and PL/SQL scripts to support reporting, data validation, performance tuning, and system automation.
  • Serve as the primary liaison with Deltek Support to engineer resolutions, manage escalations, and investigate complex issues.
  • Troubleshoot integration failures, data discrepancies, and system performance challenges, ensuring effective and timely resolution.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Finance, Payroll, HR, IT, Procurement, Program Control) to gather requirements and deliver scalable, reliable technical solutions aligned with strategic business objectives.
  • Support system upgrades, patches, enhancements, and related data interface updates.
  • Maintain strong data integrity across systems through robust testing, documentation, quality controls, and monitoring practices.
  • Provide technical leadership and best practices for Costpoint integrations, database optimization, system architecture, and change management processes.

Qualifications

Required Experience:

Bachelors degree with 10 years related experience.

Required Clearance:

US Citizenship required.

Required Skills:

  • Extensive hands-on experience with Deltek Costpoint, including configuration, data structures, workflows, integrations, and reporting.
  • Expert-level SQL and PL/SQL skills, including query optimization, performance tuning, complex troubleshooting, and advanced reporting techniques.
  • Strong experience architecting integrations using APIs, web services, middleware platforms, or cloud-based integration technologies.
  • Working knowledge of database platforms such as Oracle and SQL Server.
  • Deep understanding of enterprise finance, and procurement workflows in Costpoint
  • Proven ability to design and lead implementations, upgrades, and modernization initiatives.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Excellent communication skills, capable of presenting technical strategies to technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Skills

• Experience with Deltek Time & Expense, Costpoint BI tools, Enterprise reporting/analytics platforms, ADP, SAP/HR, Workday Adaptive, Excel, ODBC connections.
• Familiarity with HR systems, financial forecasting tools, data management platforms, and evolving enterprise architecture patterns.
• Background in government contracting or other highly regulated industries.
• Experience mentoring analysts, developers, and integration engineers.
